record.context_brief: Projectivity from semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature
record.original_question: Let (X, g) be a compact Kahler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, and assume the invariant ntf(X, g), defined using truly flat tangent vectors, equals dim X. Must h^0(X, Omega_X^q) vanish for every q > 0, and is X automatically projective?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3 ([Mat21, Problem 5.1]). Let (X, g) be a compact Kahler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature. Assume that ntf(X, g) = dim X.
Does it hold that h0(X, Omega q X ) = 0 for any q > 0?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let (X,g) be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension n, with curvature tensor R. The holomorphic sectional curvature is H(v) = R(v, v̄, v, v̄)/|v|_g^4 for nonzero v in T_xX, and g has semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature if H(v) ≥ 0 for all such v and all x in X. A nonzero tangent vector v in T_xX is called truly flat (at x) if R(v, v̄, w, w̄) = 0 for every w in T_xX. For each x in X let T_x ⊂ T_xX denote the set of truly flat vectors together with 0, and define ntf(X,g) = min over x in X of (dim_C T_xX − dim_C T_x). Thus ntf(X,g) = dim X means that at some point x in X there is no nonzero truly flat tangent vector. Assume (X,g) has semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature and ntf(X,g) = dim X. Let Ω_X^q denote the sheaf of holomorphic q-forms on X. (a) Does h^0(X, Ω_X^q) = 0 hold for every q > 0? (b) Must X be projective?
artifact.category_tag: Kähler manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work on quasi-positive curvature and projectivity establishes that a compact Kähler manifold with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature having no nonzero truly flat tangent vector at some point is projective and rationally connected. Rational connectedness implies the vanishing h^0(X, Ω_X^q) = 0 for all q > 0, so both parts are answered affirmatively.

status_evidence.title: Quasi-positive curvature and projectivity
status_evidence.snippet: compact Kahler manifold with nonnegative holomorphic sectional curvature and no nonzero truly flat tangent vector at some point is projective and rationally connected
status_evidence.claim: Compact Kahler manifolds with semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature and no truly flat vector at some point are projective and rationally connected; rational connectedness yields vanishing of holomorphic q-forms.
